name: Full or empty indicator code
description: Code indicating whether an object is full or empty.

values.name: More than one quarter volume available
values.description: More than one quarter volume available Indicates that there is more than a quarter of the volume available.

values.name: More than half volume available
values.description: More than half volume available Indicates that there is more than a half of the volume available.

values.name: More than three quarters volume available
values.description: More than three quarters volume available Indicates that there is more than three quarters of the volume available.

values.name: Empty
values.description: Empty Indicates that the object is empty.

values.name: Full
values.description: Full Indicates that the object is full.

values.name: No volume available
values.description: No volume available Indicates that there is no space available in the object.

values.name: Full, mixed consignment
values.description: Full, mixed consignment Indicates that the equipment is fully loaded, and includes a number LCL (Less Than Container Load) consignments.

values.name: Full, single consignment
values.description: Full, single consignment Indicates that the container is fully loaded with a single FCL (Full Container Load) consignment.

values.name: Part load
values.description: Part load Container represents part of a consignment declared on a single Customs declaration (i.e. the Customs declaration covers more than one container).

values.name: Part load mixed consignments
values.description: Part load mixed consignments Container represents part of the consignment declared on a single Customs declaration with the remainder being in other containers. Other goods, related to other declarations, are also in the container.

values.name: Single invoiced load
values.description: Single invoiced load Merchandise within a container/package covered by a single invoice.

values.name: Multi invoiced load
values.description: Multi invoiced load Merchandise within a container/package covered by more than one invoice.

values.name: Full load, multiple bills
values.description: Full load, multiple bills A container representing a consignment of goods for one consignee with multiple bill of lading numbers.
